en_title: Halo Fans Are Divided Over Whether Activision Should Reboot the Series and Start Fresh
cn_title: 《光环》该不该重启？粉丝意见不一
subtitle: 士官长何去何从
opus_summary: 有传闻称Activision将彻底重启《光环》，舍弃现有设定，粉丝对此意见不一。有人希望保留Bungie时期的故事，有人主张启用新角色；下一款《光环》的开发团队正在组建。

paragraphs.en: Halo fans are divided on whether or not Activision should completely reboot the franchise or keep Master Chief's story going.
paragraphs.cn: Activision应该彻底重启《光环》系列，还是延续士官长的故事？粉丝们对此意见不一。

paragraphs.en: A rumor floating around the internet from a user named TechnicalHalo suggests that Activision will totally reboot the series, throwing all of the lore out the window in favor of a fresh start. We advise you take this with a grain of salt, as we have no idea what Activision's plans are for Halo, but it has started an interesting conversation among fans. Should Activision use its first Halo game to create a clean slate for the beloved sci-fi franchise?
paragraphs.cn: 网上流传着用户TechnicalHalo的一则爆料，称Activision将彻底重启《光环》，舍弃全部既有设定，从头开始。我们建议谨慎看待这一传闻，因为Activision究竟打算如何处理《光环》，目前没人知道。不过，这则传闻引发了粉丝间一场有意思的讨论：Activision是否应该借自己制作的首款《光环》游戏，让这个深受喜爱的科幻系列重新开始？

paragraphs.en: A segment of fans are under the impression that, although Halo has gone off the rails in the last decade, there are still some elements from the newer games that are worth keeping. Bungie's contributions to the franchise (Halo: Campaign Evolved through Halo: Reach) are valued by fans, so some believe that if there's a way to retcon Halo 4 and onwards, that would be a valid option, as well. This ensures that the most beloved Chief stories remain canon, while also giving Activision an option to tell a whole new era of stories in the Halo universe.
paragraphs.cn: 部分粉丝认为，尽管《光环》在过去十年里偏离了方向，近年的作品仍有一些值得保留的内容。粉丝也珍视Bungie为系列创作的故事，即从《光环：战役进化》到《光环：致远星》的作品。因此，有人觉得，如果能通过修改设定处理《光环4》及之后的剧情，也不失为一种办法。这样既能让最受喜爱的士官长故事继续保留在正史中，也能让Activision在《光环》宇宙里讲述全新时代的故事。

paragraphs.en: "I’m against a full reboot," said one fan on Reddit . "But if they said the Bungie era is canon and everything else going forward is being rebooted, I wouldn’t be very upset. Halo 4 has grown on me over the yearsm but 5 and Infinite’s story led nowhere."
paragraphs.cn: 一位粉丝在Reddit上说：「我反对彻底重启。但如果他们说Bungie时期的作品仍属正史，其余内容从此重来，我也不会太介意。这些年我渐渐喜欢上了《光环4》，但《光环5》和《光环：无限》的故事都没有下文。」

paragraphs.en: "My only other idea for getting back to a good status quo, short of scorching everything, would be to just do what Terminator does all the time and just start from Halo 3 again. But it would basically nullify any investment people had in the last decade+, even if it wasn't much, and still give the impression there's no direction if you cop out on a true follow-up," said another .
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝说：「如果不把一切推倒重来，我能想到的另一种办法，就是像《终结者》系列经常做的那样，从《光环3》之后重新开始。但这么做基本会让人们过去十多年投入的感情落空，哪怕这份投入并不多。而且，要是回避真正的续作，还是会给人一种缺乏方向的感觉。」

paragraphs.en: That same fan suggested the idea of a full blown reboot might be born out of necessity, given Master Chief actor Steve Downes is getting older and will inevitably need to be recast if they want to tell new stories with the character.
paragraphs.cn: 这位粉丝还提出，彻底重启或许是不得已的选择：士官长的配音演员Steve Downes年事渐高，如果要继续讲述这个角色的新故事，迟早得换人配音。

paragraphs.en: "Steve Downes I just don't think is a long-term option for Chief anymore at his age and a recast is inevitable. You can keep Taylor as Cortana and the Campaign Evolved recasts but a reboot would immediately clear the deck for new versions of the characters and new actors. I'm actually more interested in a full reboot at this point than even a loose Infinite sequel. A full reboot actually sounds like more of a plan," they added.
paragraphs.cn: 这位粉丝补充道：「以Steve Downes现在的年龄，我觉得他已经不可能长期为士官长配音，换人是迟早的事。你们可以保留Taylor为科塔娜配音，也可以沿用《光环：战役进化》重新选定的配音演员，但重启能直接为新版角色和新演员腾出空间。到了现在，比起哪怕只是松散承接《光环：无限》的续作，我其实更想看到彻底重启。彻底重启听起来反而更像是有明确计划。」

paragraphs.en: Another fan echoed these sentiments of recasting Chief: "Honestly might be a good call, even if a lot of Halo fans hate the idea," said another fan. "If they’re wanting to grow the franchise again and get new eyes why saddle this fresh beginning with over 20 years of games, comics, and books. Plus, Steve Downes ain’t getting any younger and will probably be 80 by the time this game releases. Might be time to consider a new voice actor, and trying to recast Chief in a sequel feels like sacrilege."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝也赞同为士官长更换配音演员：「老实说，这或许是个好决定，尽管很多《光环》粉丝讨厌这个想法。如果他们想让系列重新发展、吸引新玩家，为什么还要让这个新起点背负二十多年来游戏、漫画和书籍积累的内容？况且Steve Downes也在变老，等这款游戏推出时，他可能都80岁了。或许该考虑换一位配音演员了，但在续作里给士官长换人配音，又感觉像是亵渎。」

paragraphs.en: Some think it's time to leave Chief behind altogether, regardless of how Activision handles the timeline, and embrace other stories in the Halo universe, similar to Halo 3: ODST and Halo: Reach.
paragraphs.cn: 还有人认为，不管Activision如何处理时间线，都该暂时放下士官长，转而讲述《光环》宇宙中的其他故事，就像《光环3：ODST》和《光环：致远星》那样。

paragraphs.en: "Reboot? Okay thats fine," one fan said . "Just make it a Halo reboot and not Master Chief reboot. Give me Halo games with new characters akin to Reach or ODST."
paragraphs.cn: 一位粉丝说：「重启？可以，没问题。但请重启《光环》，别只重启士官长。我想玩到像《光环：致远星》或《光环3：ODST》那样、由新角色担纲的《光环》游戏。」

paragraphs.en: "I think it would be a shame to completely overwrite everything after Halo 3 since there is some good stuff there in the storylines told outside of the games," said another fan . "I think the best bet would be to just leave the current storyline as is and go either forward or backwards in the timeline and tell new stories with new characters that are mostly disconnected from what came before."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝说：「我觉得，把《光环3》之后的一切彻底抹去会很可惜，因为游戏之外讲述的故事中也有一些不错的内容。我认为最好的办法是保留现有剧情，然后把时间线往前或往后推进，用新角色讲述与此前内容基本无关的新故事。」

paragraphs.en: It was confirmed yesterday that Activision would be building a new team to make the next Halo game , while Halo Studios was gutted by layoffs. It's unclear if any of the Call of Duty studios will be assisting on the project, as Sledgehammer Games has long been rumored to be eyeing the Halo franchise. It will likely be a while before the next Halo materializes, especially if Activision is throwing everything out and starting from scratch. Only time will tell what happens, but it'll be interesting to see what direction they take it in regardles.
paragraphs.cn: 昨天已有消息证实，Activision将组建新团队开发下一款《光环》，与此同时，Halo Studios因裁员而遭受重创。目前尚不清楚《使命召唤》系列的开发工作室是否会参与协助；长期以来，一直有传闻称Sledgehammer Games有意参与《光环》系列。下一款《光环》恐怕还要等上一段时间才会面世，尤其是在Activision决定舍弃现有内容、从头开始的情况下。最终会怎样，只有时间能给出答案；但无论如何，Activision会让系列走向何方，都值得关注。
